definitions.explanation: A large volume or amount of something. Can function as a noun or as a na-adjective modifier.

examples.english: To drink a large amount of water.

examples.japanese: ⟦アルコール→アルコール：01771_arukooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{多量|たりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: Consuming alcohol in large quantities is dangerous.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{多量|たりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}する→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Taking this medicine in large doses may cause side effects.

notes:
{多量|たりょう} combines {多|た} (many, much) and ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (quantity, amount).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多量|たりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (a large amount of...)
- {多量|たりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to consume in large quantities)
- {多量|たりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧ (to contain in large amounts)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {多量|たりょう} vs. ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧: Both mean "large quantity," but ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧ is more common in everyday usage and implies a greater scale. {多量|たりょう} tends to appear in technical, medical, or scientific contexts.
- ⟦{少量|しょうりょう}→少量：12436_shouryou⟧ is the antonym (small quantity).
